## An insurance book {#sec-aggregate-insurance}

*This is a recipe for* a realistically-calibrated insurance aggregate — plan
premium at a target loss ratio, a basic limit, a thick-tailed severity, a
mixed-Poisson count. This is the **house book**, and the `show` flow here is the
one every later page reuses.

```{python}
from _setup import *
```

**Beat 1 — the DecL.**

```{python}
pp(house('Gross'))
```

**Beats 2 & 3 — build, validate, exhibits.**

```{python}
gross = build(house('Gross'))
show(gross)
```

**Beat 4 — the check.** [Check-Reconciliation] + [Check-Independent-Oracle]

```{python}
# aggregate mean ≈ E[N] × E[X]; est vs theoretic to grid accuracy
print(f'agg mean       {gross.actual_m:,.1f}')
print(f'E[N] × E[X]    {gross.n * gross.sev_m:,.1f}')
print(f'est vs theoretic mean  {gross.est_m:,.2f}  vs  {gross.actual_m:,.2f}')
```
